attributes.name: [Temporal OTel] Service latency p99 below 100ms 99% rolling 30 days
attributes.description: Measures whether the 99th-percentile gRPC frontend latency of the Temporal Cloud service stays below 100 milliseconds (0.1 seconds) within each 1-minute evaluation window. The Temporal Cloud frontend is the single API entry-point for all client operations including starting workflows, signalling executions, and polling for tasks — latency spikes here propagate directly to workflow orchestration responsiveness. Breaching this SLO warrants investigation of Temporal Cloud service health or upstream capacity limits. Target: 99% of 1-minute timeslices report healthy p99 latency, grouped by namespace and operation to isolate which API methods are affected.
